GALLERY RECORD TERMINAL C
FINAL SILO LOG<New>Verified human launch order
was not received. Remaining
warheads are secured in
maintenance isolation.<New>Central power unstable.
Evacuation incomplete.
Custodian seal engaged.
Hold until recognized
command authority returns.<New>FINAL MAINTENANCE NOTE
Every weapon left here marks
one launch the world was
spared.<New><Emeralda>
"Someone chose not to launch
them."<New><Elly>
"Missiles standing in rows...
like tombstones in a
graveyard."<New><Elly>
"Monuments to Zeboim's pride
and arrogance."<New><Citan>
"And one unopened path to the
sky. What we send through it
will decide what this machine
means today."<New><Citan>
"Central Control is beyond
the far bulkhead."<Close>
